reason: Fast Closure V2 protocol candidate PR #436 proves that exact AGENTS.md routing is now correctly GOVERNANCE_WP0 and all layered governance contracts are GREEN, but the base-owned trusted implementation branch policy still rejects an exact AGENTS-only non-executable protocol-document branch as WP0_REJECTED_STAGE_TARGET_DENIED. This work package adds one strict root-protocol document transport to the existing trusted parser so an exact AGENTS.md-only candidate can be validated without gaining implementation authority. It does not authorize arbitrary documentation branches, product code, workflow changes, dependencies, or a second parser.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().

requiredSemantics: An exact candidate whose trusted-main diff is exactly AGENTS.md may be admitted only as non-executable root protocol document transport.
Transport must grant implementationAuthorityGranted=false and must never make the branch an implementation authority.
AGENTS.md must be a regular non-executable blob at mode 100644 and must be present at the evaluated head.
The trusted-main diff must contain exactly one path, AGENTS.md, with no rename ambiguity or adjacent file.
Existing arbitrary branch denial, generic delegated governance authorization transport, failure-first topology, and sealed OSS semantics remain unchanged.
forbiddenSemantics: No docs/ prefix or wildcard branch authorization.
No product, runtime, workflow, dependency, release, test, or governance JSON path may enter this transport.
No implementation authority may be inferred from protocol-document transport.
No warning-only fallback or Stage-only exception.

reviewedCandidates.name: Existing implementationBranchPolicy trusted parser
reviewedCandidates.reason: It already owns branch admission, exact changed-file resolution, trusted Git topology, proposal transport and implementation-authority decisions; extending this same parser avoids a parallel policy engine.

reviewedCandidates.name: Existing generic delegated authorization proposal transport
reviewedCandidates.reason: It proves the non-authoritative transport pattern but is intentionally limited to one authorization JSON path and must not be widened to AGENTS.md.

retireOrAvoid: Do not add a second parser, workflow, script, branch registry or documentation authority service.
Do not widen authorization-proposal transport to arbitrary Markdown.
Do not add a docs branch regex as an authority substitute for exact content/topology validation.

requiredBoundaries: legacy and Fast Closure V2 failure-first preservation

focusAreas: generic delegated proposal and arbitrary branch denial remain fail closed
